The '''Canterse Spread''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] rotating around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Julevia]] in the [[Julevian system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Canterse Spread was situated between the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system, [[Proxida]], and the third, [[Gologry]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Julevian system]], except [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], was first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
